report.summary: The social-network deployment is failing on DNS name resolution of the service name `user-service`. The CoreDNS ConfigMap `kube-system/coredns` contains an injected `template` block whose zone is `user-service.social-network.svc.cluster.local` and whose response is `rcode NXDOMAIN`. Clients that must resolve `user-service` get `getaddrinfo() ... Name or service not known`: the pod `compose-post-service-659bfc5898-nscpf` logged 77 such failures for `<Host: user-service Port: 9090>` plus `Failed to connect user-service-client` in the final 14 s of the window (197 error lines over 20 min), and at the same instants the pod `nginx-thrift-68bc7d94df-9p872` (Jaeger service `nginx-web-server`) logged 77 `compose.lua:62: ComposePost(): compost_post failure: Could not resolve host for client socket` errors for `POST /wrk2-api/post/compose` (e.g. 14:29:51.850 vs 14:29:51.849), so post composition fails end-to-end. Resolution of other names still works (`user-timeline-service.social-network.svc.cluster.local` resolved, and user-timeline-service reached `user-timeline-mongodb`), the `user-service` Service and Endpoints exist (10.96.42.128 / 10.244.7.208) and the user-service pod itself is Ready, so this is a DNS fault, not a crashed or unhealthy user-service. The earlier 500s on `/wrk2-api/user-timeline/read` and the connection-refused lines at 14:29:40-14:29:43 are startup transients of the fresh 14:29:27-14:29:33 rollout (user-timeline-service began serving at 14:29:43) and are not the current failure.
